raw_text: BREAKING: New satellite imagery from Planet Labs shows fresh construction at Finger 8 on Pangong Tso's north bank. A prefabricated bridge structure is clearly visible spanning a narrow inlet. This matches PLA engineering corps patterns observed during the 2020 standoff. Thread with annotated imagery below.
